Usage:
  docbank document add <path>... [flags]

Flags:
      --allow-http            allow HTTP downloads and redirects
      --dest string           virtual destination directory (default "/inbox")
      --exclude stringArray   exclude files or directories matching a basename or source-relative path pattern (repeatable)
  -h, --help                  help for add
      --include stringArray   include files matching a basename or source-relative path pattern (repeatable)
      --json                  print JSON to stdout (progress suppressed)
      --max-bytes int         maximum URL download size in bytes (default 100000000)
      --preflight             inventory sources without opening content or changing the vault
      --progress string       progress output mode: auto, bar, or plain (suppressed by --json) (default "auto")
      --replace               version the file already at each destination path instead of adding a suffixed sibling
